# Cedar Point Logistics — Pipeline Deal (Business Services)

> Not to be confused with portfolio company
> [Cedar Park Health](cedar-park-health.md) — similar name, different company. Cedar Point is a
> **pipeline deal SCP does not yet own**; Cedar Park Health is an owned portfolio company.

- **What it is:** a third-party logistics (3PL) / freight-brokerage business; a **new-deal
  opportunity** in evaluation, sourced under [David Okonkwo](../people/david-okonkwo.md).
- **Sponsor:** David Okonkwo; modeling by [Sophie Laurent](../people/sophie-laurent.md) (took the
  model over from departed [Daniel Kim](../people/daniel-kim.md)).
- **Status:** **early evaluation.** Passed first screen; an IC memo decision is pending — Kate is
  lukewarm on the cyclicality. TEV in the ~$110M range.
